title_en: Prophetic Measures to Safeguard the Caliphate from the Umayyad Coup (Part 3-49)
description_en: المرجعية والخلافة بعد الرسول (ص) 20 / جمادي الأول /1433
summary: His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari discusses prophetic strategies and measures taken to protect the leadership of the Muslim community (umma) after the Prophet.
series_en: Debates in Creed - The Religious Authority and the Caliphate after the Messenger
